keyFindings.description: The intake stop runs in a defer after serveUntilStopped, but shutdown() closes database.Pool as soon as HTTP has drained and no pool connection is in use. A handler waiting on GitHub holds no connection, so the pool closes under it; its upsert then fails, and deliver acknowledges the message because handling is not cancelled. The message is not handed back to the next holder as the PR's stop design says; only the next reconcile (about 5.5 min) recovers it. Stop the intakes (or at least wait for their handlers) before waitUntilIdle/pool.Close, or hand back a message whose route failed after the pool closed.

intakeDelivery.sub is the handle Subscribe returned. After the bus restores the registration on a replaced connection (restoreSubscriptions installs a new active handle, subscribed unchanged), stop drains the dead original handle: Drain errors (a false ERROR line), the drain wait is skipped, and the held messages are negatively acknowledged while the restored subscription is still bound here, so NATS redelivers them to this process and giveBack Naks them again until Release unsubscribes it. Drain the registration's current handle.
Header lines name the pre-renumbering files (0137 says 0136_reference_excerpt_backoff, which is another migration's number). Cleanup.

Two deadlines own one stop (intakeStopBudget 15 s in delivery, intakeStopDeadline 25 s in main), and intakeStopBudget's comment repeats cmd/dispatch's shutdown arithmetic. Cleanup; the M1 fix may settle it.

Unused surface: pglisten.Notification/Listener.OnNotification/PID (no production caller), WokenLoop.HeldRetry always equal to MinGap, intakeDelivery.stopping redundant with keyedRunner.stopped if keys.stop runs before Drain. Cleanup.
intake.go grows from 968 to 1219 lines; the subscription/stop subsystem (subscribeDurable..negativelyAcknowledge) can live in its own file beside keyed.go. Cleanup.

Two clock conventions: edit notices read a database-relative wait, the embedding queue and excerpt retry read an absolute timestamptz timed on the host clock; the cost is bounded by host/database skew. Not a defect at NTP skew; align when touching.

Wakes are not lost: hub signals every wake after each LISTEN; buffered wake survives a running pass; held lease retried; late-committing suggestions stay swept=false and are judged against all their events; young events stop the cursor.
